recipes.name: Pepperoncini roast
ingredients: 1 jar pepperoncinis (2 jars for more spice)
steps: Put the roast in the crock pot.
Add the au jus packet, ranch packet, and pepperoncinis.
Cut the butter into slices and spread them over the top.
Cook on high for 6 hours or low for 8 hours.

recipes.name: Megan's zuppa toscana
steps: Cut the bacon into small pieces. Cook it in a pot on medium-high for 5 minutes.
Add the sausage. Cook about 15 minutes until browned and crispy, stirring now and then.
Spoon off most of the fat. Leave a few tablespoons.
Chop the onion and mince the garlic. Stir them in and cook 2 to 3 minutes.
Dice the potatoes with skins on. Add the broth, water, potatoes, and Italian seasoning.
Bring to a boil on high. Turn down to medium-low and simmer 10 to 15 minutes, until the potatoes are tender.
Remove the kale stems and tear the leaves into bite-size pieces.
Stir in the cream and kale. Cook about 5 minutes, until the kale wilts.
Season with salt and pepper.
recipes.notes: Hot Italian sausage or 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes adds heat. Half-and-half works in place of cream. Keeps 3 to 4 days in the fridge.

recipes.name: Korean beef bowls
steps: Stir the soy sauce, brown sugar and red pepper flakes together in a small bowl.
Brown the beef in a large skillet on medium-high for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up. Spoon off the fat.
Push the beef to the side. Add the sesame oil, garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute, then stir it all together.
Pour in the sauce and simmer 2 to 3 minutes, until it thickens a little.
Serve over rice with green onions and sesame seeds on top.
recipes.notes: Good with a fried egg, kimchi or quick cucumbers on the side. A spoon of gochujang in the sauce adds heat.

recipes.name: Sheet pan chicken shawarma
ingredients: 4 cloves garlic (minced, 3 for the chicken and 1 for the sauce)
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Mix the olive oil, 2 tbsp lemon juice, spices, salt, pepper and 3 cloves of garlic in a big bowl. Add the chicken and onion and toss to coat.
Spread the chicken and onion on a sheet pan. Roast for 25 minutes, until the chicken is browned at the edges.
While it roasts, stir the yogurt, 1 tbsp lemon juice, the last clove of garlic and a pinch of salt together for the sauce.
Let the chicken rest 5 minutes, then slice it.
Serve in warm pitas with the garlic sauce, cucumber and tomatoes.
recipes.notes: The chicken can sit in the spices overnight in the fridge for more flavor. Also good over rice instead of in pitas.

recipes.name: Marry me chicken
ingredients: 2 large chicken breasts (cut in half the long way)
steps: Season the chicken with salt, pepper and Italian seasoning.
Heat the oil in a large skillet on medium-high. Sear the chicken 4 to 5 minutes a side, until golden. Set it on a plate.
Turn the heat to medium. Melt the butter, add the garlic and sun-dried tomatoes and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the broth, scraping up the brown bits, then the cream, parmesan and red pepper flakes.
Put the chicken back in the pan. Simmer 8 to 10 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce thickens.
Top with basil. Serve with pasta, rice or crusty bread.
recipes.notes: A handful of spinach stirred into the sauce at the end works well.

recipes.name: Smash burger tacos
steps: Stir the mayo, ketchup, mustard and pickle juice together for the sauce.
Split the beef into 8 balls. Mix the salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Heat a griddle or large skillet on medium-high. Set a beef ball on a tortilla and press it flat and thin all the way to the edges. Do the rest the same way.
Put them in the pan meat side down, a few at a time. Sprinkle with the seasoning and cook for 3 minutes, until the beef is browned and crispy.
Flip so the tortilla is down. Add a slice of cheese and cook 1 to 2 minutes more, until the cheese melts and the tortilla is crisp.
Top with lettuce, pickles, onion and the sauce. Fold and eat right away.
recipes.notes: Wet hands or a piece of parchment keep the beef from sticking when you press it.

recipes.name: Quick butter chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb boneless chicken thighs (cut in bite-size pieces)
2 tsp garam masala (1 for the chicken, 1 for the sauce)
steps: Toss the chicken with the yogurt, 1 tsp garam masala and the salt.
Melt 1 tbsp butter in a large pot on medium-high. Cook the chicken 6 to 8 minutes, until browned. Set it aside.
Melt the rest of the butter. Cook the onion 5 minutes, until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger, cumin, paprika, chili powder and the rest of the garam masala. Stir 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato sauce and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in the cream and put the chicken back in. Simmer 5 to 10 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
Top with cilantro. Serve over rice with naan.
recipes.notes: Taste before serving and add salt or a pinch of sugar if the tomatoes are sharp. Freezes well.

recipes.name: Cajun shrimp and sausage skillet
steps: Toss the shrimp with 1 tsp Cajun seasoning.
Heat the oil in a large skillet on medium-high. Brown the sausage 4 to 5 minutes. Set it aside.
Add the peppers and onion. Cook 5 minutes, until soft. Stir in the garlic, corn and the rest of the Cajun seasoning and cook 2 minutes.
Push the vegetables to the side. Melt the butter and add the shrimp in one layer. Cook 2 minutes a side, until pink.
Put the sausage back in and stir it all together. Squeeze the lemon over and top with parsley.
Serve over rice or with crusty bread.
recipes.notes: Cajun seasoning is salty, so taste before adding any salt.

recipes.name: Sausage gnocchi skillet
steps: Heat the oil in a large skillet on medium-high. Add the gnocchi in one layer and cook 5 minutes, turning, until golden. Set them aside.
Brown the sausage in the same pan for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up.
Add the onion and cook 3 minutes, then the garlic for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomatoes, broth and cream. Simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in the gnocchi, spinach and parmesan. Cook 2 minutes, until the spinach wilts. Season with salt and pepper.
recipes.notes: Browning the gnocchi first keeps them from going gummy. A ball of mozzarella torn over the top and a few minutes under the broiler makes it cheesy.

recipes.name: Philly cheesesteaks
steps: Put the steak in the freezer for 30 minutes so it slices thin. Slice it as thin as you can across the grain.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet on medium-high. Cook the onion, pepper and mushrooms 8 to 10 minutes, until soft and browned. Set them aside.
Add the rest of the oil. Spread the steak in the pan, season with salt and pepper, and cook 3 to 4 minutes, stirring and chopping it with the spatula.
Stir the vegetables back in and split it into 4 piles. Lay 2 slices of provolone on each and cover the pan for 1 minute to melt.
Butter the rolls and toast them in another pan or under the broiler.
Slide each pile into a roll with the spatula.
recipes.notes: Shaved steak from the meat counter skips the freezing and slicing. Cheez Whiz instead of provolone is the classic Philly way.

recipes.name: Lasagna soup
ingredients: 1 tsp black pepper (half for the soup, half for the cheese)
steps: Brown the sausage and onion in a Dutch oven on medium-high, breaking up the sausage, about 5 minutes, until no pink is left and the onion is soft.
Add the garlic and cook 20 seconds, until fragrant. Drain off the extra fat.
Pour in the broth and scrape up the bits from the bottom. Stir in the marinara, crushed tomatoes, pesto, 1/2 tsp of the pepper, the salt and the red pepper flakes.

Bring to a boil and add the broken noodles. Turn down to a gentle bubble and cook uncovered about 15 minutes, stirring now and then, until the pasta is tender. Add a splash of broth if it gets too thick.
While it simmers, stir the ricotta, mozzarella and the other 1/2 tsp of pepper together in a bowl.
Ladle the soup into bowls and top each with a big spoonful of the cheese mix. Add more pesto if you like and grate parmesan over the top.
recipes.notes: If you won't eat the whole pot at once, cook the noodles separately and add them to each bowl, so the leftovers don't get soggy. Keep the cheese mix separate too and add it when serving. 12 oz of small pasta like rotini or bow ties works in place of the lasagna noodles. Ground beef or turkey works in place of the sausage. Keeps 3 days in the fridge, or 3 months in the freezer without the noodles and cheese.
